-- ── Constants (ref-lua l.1-2) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Globals, as the reference declares them: NUM_FACTIONS_DISPLAYED is the row-slot count the -- XML below instantiates, REPUTATIONFRAME_FACTIONHEIGHT the faux kit's pixel value step. NUM_FACTIONS_DISPLAYED = 15 REPUTATIONFRAME_FACTIONHEIGHT = 26
-- ── GlobalStrings (ref-GlobalStrings.lua, cited per line) ─────────────────────────────── -- The `X = X or "..."` idiom is this codebase's convention: the app runs the real localized -- GlobalStrings.lua off the patch chain BEFORE any window file, so the installed locale -- wins and these copies only fill in for the test harnesses, which load no chain. FACTION = FACTION or "Faction" -- :1938 STANDING = STANDING or "Standing" -- :4193 AT_WAR = AT_WAR or "At War" -- :77 MOVE_TO_INACTIVE = MOVE_TO_INACTIVE or "Move to Inactive" -- :2706 SHOW_FACTION_ON_MAINSCREEN = SHOW_FACTION_ON_MAINSCREEN or "Show as Experience Bar" -- :3438 REPUTATION_FACTION_DESCRIPTION = REPUTATION_FACTION_DESCRIPTION or "These are the factions that you have interacted with." -- :3330 REPUTATION_STANDING_DESCRIPTION = REPUTATION_STANDING_DESCRIPTION or "The further to the right your standing bar is the closer you are to improving your reputation to the next tier with that faction. The Standing Levels in order are Hated, Hostile, Unfriendly, Neutral, Friendly, Honored, Revered and Exalted." -- :3331 REPUTATION_STATUS_AT_WAR = REPUTATION_STATUS_AT_WAR or "You are currently at war with this group." -- :3333 REPUTATION_AT_WAR_DESCRIPTION = REPUTATION_AT_WAR_DESCRIPTION or "This determines how you will interact with members of this faction. If you have at war checked then your default behavior will be to attack them. If you do not have it checked you will not be able to attack them. " -- :3329
-- The two SYNTHETIC header names. The engine reads these globals out of the VM itself -- (reputation.rs `synthetic_header`), which is the only reason either string has a consumer -- at all: GlobalStrings.lua defines both and no reference FrameXML file anywhere reads -- them, because the real client builds the list C-side. `FACTION_OTHER` heads the -- parentless bucket (key 0); `FACTION_INACTIVE` heads the bucket a faction moves to when -- the popup's "Move to Inactive" box is ticked (key -1), which the engine folds by default -- on every rebuild, exactly as the client does. FACTION_OTHER = FACTION_OTHER or "Other" -- :1943 FACTION_INACTIVE = FACTION_INACTIVE or "Inactive" -- :1942
-- The eight standing names, and their `_FEMALE` twins (:1947-1962). enUS spells both the -- same; a localized client's own GlobalStrings.lua overwrites the pair and the gender rule -- in BenillaReputation_StandingLabel starts mattering. FACTION_STANDING_LABEL1 = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL1 or "Hated" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL2 = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL2 or "Hostile" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL3 = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL3 or "Unfriendly" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL4 = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL4 or "Neutral" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL5 = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL5 or "Friendly" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL6 = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL6 or "Honored" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL7 = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL7 or "Revered" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL8 = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL8 or "Exalted" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL1_FEMALE = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL1_FEMALE or "Hated" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL2_FEMALE = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL2_FEMALE or "Hostile" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL3_FEMALE = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL3_FEMALE or "Unfriendly" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL4_FEMALE = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL4_FEMALE or "Neutral" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL5_FEMALE = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL5_FEMALE or "Friendly" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL6_FEMALE = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL6_FEMALE or "Honored" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL7_FEMALE = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL7_FEMALE or "Revered" FACTION_STANDING_LABEL8_FEMALE = FACTION_STANDING_LABEL8_FEMALE or "Exalted"
-- `FACTION_BAR_COLORS` (ref-lua l.3-12) is NOT declared here: it lives in ActionBar.xml -- beside `ReputationWatchBar_Update`, its other consumer, because that file must be able to -- index it with no reputation file loaded and this one cannot be loaded without it (this -- file's header comment, deviation 1). ActionBar.xml is manifest entry 94 against this -- file's 213, so the table is always there by the time a row paints.
-- The standing name for `standingID` (1..8) at the player's gender — the reference's -- `GetText("FACTION_STANDING_LABEL"..standingID, gender)` (ref-lua l.65) with its C-side -- lookup collapsed (this file's header comment, deviation 2). `UnitSex` answers 2 for male -- and 3 for female, which is the value the reference passes straight through. function BenillaReputation_StandingLabel(standingID, gender) if gender == 3 then local female = getglobal("FACTION_STANDING_LABEL" .. standingID .. "_FEMALE") if female then return female end end return getglobal("FACTION_STANDING_LABEL" .. standingID) or "" end
-- Fill the detail popup for the row at `factionIndex` — ref-lua l.106-133, split out of -- the update loop only so that function stays readable; the body is the reference's, -- branch for branch. Called only when the popup is up AND this row is the selected one. function BenillaReputationDetail_Fill(factionIndex, name, description, atWarWith, canToggleAtWar, isWatched) ReputationDetailFactionName:SetText(name) ReputationDetailFactionDescription:SetText(description) if atWarWith then ReputationDetailAtWarCheckBox:SetChecked(1) else ReputationDetailAtWarCheckBox:SetChecked(nil) end if canToggleAtWar then ReputationDetailAtWarCheckBox:Enable() ReputationDetailAtWarCheckBoxText:SetTextColor(RED_FONT_COLOR.r, RED_FONT_COLOR.g, RED_FONT_COLOR.b) else ReputationDetailAtWarCheckBox:Disable() ReputationDetailAtWarCheckBoxText:SetTextColor(GRAY_FONT_COLOR.r, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.g, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.b) end if IsFactionInactive(factionIndex) then ReputationDetailInactiveCheckBox:SetChecked(1) else ReputationDetailInactiveCheckBox:SetChecked(nil) end if isWatched then ReputationDetailMainScreenCheckBox:SetChecked(1) else ReputationDetailMainScreenCheckBox:SetChecked(nil) end end
-- The list page (ref-lua ReputationFrame_Update, l.32-149) — transcribed whole, onto the -- house faux-scroll kit and with the reference's own unread `rightBarTexture` local dropped -- (this file's header comment, deviation 6). function ReputationFrame_Update() local numFactions = GetNumFactions() local scrollFrame = getglobal("ReputationListScrollFrame")
-- ref-lua l.39-41. The reset is a no-op in every reachable case — FauxScrollFrame_Update -- has already clamped `frame.offset` to 0 when the list fits and seated the bar at -- `offset * valueStep`, so this SetValue writes the value the Slider already holds and -- its change-gate (decision 0250) drops it before it could re-enter this function. -- Kept because it is the reference's line, not because it does anything. if not FauxScrollFrame_Update(scrollFrame, numFactions, NUM_FACTIONS_DISPLAYED, REPUTATIONFRAME_FACTIONHEIGHT) then getglobal("ReputationListScrollFrameScrollBar"):SetValue(0) end local factionOffset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame)
local gender = UnitSex("player") for i = 1, NUM_FACTIONS_DISPLAYED do local factionIndex = factionOffset + i local factionBar = getglobal("ReputationBar" .. i) local factionHeader = getglobal("ReputationHeader" .. i) local factionCheck = getglobal("ReputationBar" .. i .. "Check") if factionIndex <= numFactions then local name, description, standingID, barMin, barMax, barValue, atWarWith, canToggleAtWar, isHeader, isCollapsed, isWatched = GetFactionInfo(factionIndex) if isHeader then -- ref-lua l.52-63. factionHeader:SetText(name) if isCollapsed then factionHeader:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up") else factionHeader:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up") end factionHeader.index = factionIndex factionHeader.isCollapsed = isCollapsed factionBar:Hide() factionHeader:Show() factionCheck:Hide() else -- ref-lua l.65-139. local factionStanding = BenillaReputation_StandingLabel(standingID, gender) local factionName = getglobal("ReputationBar" .. i .. "FactionName") factionName:SetText(name) getglobal("ReputationBar" .. i .. "FactionStanding"):SetText(factionStanding)
local atWarIndicator = getglobal("ReputationBar" .. i .. "AtWarCheck") if atWarWith then atWarIndicator:Show() else atWarIndicator:Hide() end
-- Normalize values (ref-lua l.79-82). The engine hands these over ABSOLUTE -- for exactly this reason: reputation.rs's module doc names the reference's -- own three lines as the contract the tuple is written against. barMax = barMax - barMin barValue = barValue - barMin barMin = 0
factionBar.id = factionIndex factionBar.standingText = factionStanding factionBar.tooltip = HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. " " .. barValue .. " / " .. barMax .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE factionBar:SetMinMaxValues(0, barMax) factionBar:SetValue(barValue) -- UNGUARDED, deliberately, exactly as the reference has it (ref-lua l.89). -- `GetFactionInfo` is eleven wide on EVERY path including a miss, and its -- miss puts the client's own `1` in the standingID slot for precisely this -- index (reputation.rs `unknown_faction`) — so the reference's own -- `factionIndex <= numFactions` gate above is belt, and that `1` is braces. -- Adding a nil-check here would be inventing a branch the client does not -- have and cannot reach. local color = FACTION_BAR_COLORS[standingID] factionBar:SetStatusBarColor(color.r, color.g, color.b) factionBar:SetID(factionIndex) factionBar:Show() factionHeader:Hide()
-- The watched checkmark rides the END of the name string, so the name box -- narrows by 10 to make room (ref-lua l.95-103, verbatim). if isWatched then factionCheck:Show() factionName:SetWidth(100) factionCheck:SetPoint("LEFT", factionName, "LEFT", factionName:GetStringWidth(), 0) else factionCheck:Hide() factionName:SetWidth(110) end
-- ref-lua l.105-139: the selected row wears the highlight pair, and fills -- the popup if it is open. if factionIndex == GetSelectedFaction() then if ReputationDetailFrame:IsShown() then BenillaReputationDetail_Fill(factionIndex, name, description, atWarWith, canToggleAtWar, isWatched) end getglobal("ReputationBar" .. i .. "Highlight1"):Show() getglobal("ReputationBar" .. i .. "Highlight2"):Show() else getglobal("ReputationBar" .. i .. "Highlight1"):Hide() getglobal("ReputationBar" .. i .. "Highlight2"):Hide() end end else factionHeader:Hide() factionBar:Hide() end end -- ref-lua l.146-148: nothing selected means nothing to detail. `GetSelectedFaction` -- answers 0 both for "never selected" and for "the selected faction is folded away -- under a collapsed header" (reputation.rs), so a fold closes the popup too. if GetSelectedFaction() == 0 then ReputationDetailFrame:Hide() end end
-- A bar click toggles the popup for that faction (ref-lua ReputationBar_OnClick, -- l.151-159). Parameterless and reading `this`, exactly as the reference writes it: our -- dispatcher sets `this` before invoking a handler (script/event.rs `invoke_with_globals`) -- and it stays set through the call, the same contract ScrollTemplates.xml's -- `FauxScrollFrame_OnVerticalScroll` already relies on. function ReputationBar_OnClick() if ReputationDetailFrame:IsShown() and (GetSelectedFaction() == this.id) then ReputationDetailFrame:Hide() else SetSelectedFaction(this.id) ReputationDetailFrame:Show() ReputationFrame_Update() end end
-- A header click folds or unfolds its group (ref l.9-15, the template's own OnClick). -- THE ADDED LINE is the repaint: the reference's `Collapse`/`ExpandFactionHeader` are C -- bindings that raise UPDATE_FACTION on their way out, ours are pure model writes (this -- file's header comment, deviation 3) — SkillFrame.xml's `BenillaSkillTypeLabel_OnClick` -- carries the identical addition for the identical reason. -- -- `header.index` is the slot's own VISIBLE row index, stamped by the update loop that last -- painted it, and it must stay that: an index that is not a header — `0`, a bar row, a stale -- one past the end — folds or unfolds EVERY header instead (the client's own fall-through at -- `0x4d6a50`/`0x4d6aa0`, which reputation.rs reproduces). Nothing here can reach that arm, -- because a slot only ever shows its header twin while the loop has just written a header -- index into it; the note is here so a future edit does not reach it by accident. function BenillaReputationHeader_OnClick(header) if header.isCollapsed then ExpandFactionHeader(header.index) else CollapseFactionHeader(header.index) end ReputationFrame_Update() end
-- The popup's three boxes (ref l.758-766, l.810-818, l.839-848). The at-war box is the -- reference's own body unchanged — it already repaints. The inactive box gains the added -- repaint (this file's header comment, deviation 3): its flip re-parents the row under the -- "Inactive" header there and then, so the list on screen is stale the moment it returns. -- The main-screen box gets NO addition — see the same note for why the round trip, not a -- repaint, is what moves the watched checkmark. function BenillaReputationAtWarBox_OnClick(box) FactionToggleAtWar(GetSelectedFaction()) if box:GetChecked() then PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") else PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOff") end ReputationFrame_Update() end
function BenillaReputationInactiveBox_OnClick(box) if box:GetChecked() then PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") SetFactionInactive(GetSelectedFaction()) else PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOff") SetFactionActive(GetSelectedFaction()) end ReputationFrame_Update() end
function BenillaReputationMainScreenBox_OnClick(box) if box:GetChecked() then PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") SetWatchedFactionIndex(GetSelectedFaction()) else PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOff") SetWatchedFactionIndex(0) end ReputationWatchBar_Update() end
-- The window's wheel handler (this file's header comment, deviation 7). function BenillaReputationFrame_OnMouseWheel(delta) BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(getglobal("ReputationListScrollFrame"), delta) end
-- ── Lifecycle (ref-lua l.16-30) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function ReputationFrame_OnLoad() local frame = this frame:RegisterEvent("UPDATE_FACTION") -- The faux kit's one wiring requirement: the owner names its own repaint so a drag of -- the scroll bar re-binds the rows (ScrollTemplates.xml's `frame.updateFunc` contract). getglobal("ReputationListScrollFrame").updateFunc = ReputationFrame_Update end
function ReputationFrame_OnShow() ReputationFrame_Update() end
function ReputationFrame_OnEvent(event) if event == "UPDATE_FACTION" then if this:IsVisible() then ReputationFrame_Update() end end end

Scripts.OnEnter: if (this.tooltip) then getglobal(this:GetName() .. "FactionStanding"):SetText(this.tooltip) end getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Highlight1"):Show() getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Highlight2"):Show()
Scripts.OnLeave: getglobal(this:GetName() .. "FactionStanding"):SetText(this.standingText) if (GetSelectedFaction() ~= this.id) then getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Highlight1"):Hide() getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Highlight2"):Hide() end
